leadText:
Turner (Japanese: イッコン Ikkon) is a character of the day who appeared in Breaking Titles at the Chateau!. He is the head of the house of the Battle Chateau and a .

He greeted , , Nico and Chester when they came to visit the Battle Chateau; and ushered them to the salon filled with other "knights". He also informed the group about the Battle Chateau's history. Afterwards, Turner announced the following battle between Ash and Chester.

Turner makes efforts to keep the Battle Chateau, a historic Kalos institution, as authentic and dignified as ever.

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
Turner's design is based on the from . More specifically, Turner is based on the butler who welcomes the and gives them information about the Battle Chateau and its ranks. 
In the Battle Chateau, there is a Duke named Turner who has appearance of a Butler, but his Japanese name is ワリミズ Warimizu. In the Japanese version, Ikkon is also the name of a Duke, but he has the appearance of a and his English name is Hennessy.
